adresowo.label: Adresowo
adresowo.notes: Server-rendered cards; detail schema.org Place geo + labelled parameter list. Path pagination (_l2, _l3), region aliases fma/fsl.

alertyprzetargowe.label: Alerty Przetargowe (Otoprzetargi)
alertyprzetargowe.notes: Server-rendered Otoprzetargi register; detail pages expose source coordinates and full descriptions.

axiimmo.label: AXI IMMO
axiimmo.notes: WordPress + schema.org JSON-LD; precise map-marker coordinates; /page/N/ pagination.

domiporta.label: Domiporta
domiporta.notes: Schema.org JSON-LD for regular and premium listings; detail pages expose geo coordinates and full descriptions.

domy.label: Domy.pl
domy.notes: Server-rendered HTML; detail pages expose coordinates and full descriptions.

flats.label: Flats.pl
flats.notes: Embedded Next.js RSC listing objects; detail lat/lng + description.

gdom.label: Gdom
gdom.notes: Nationwide HivePress site; detail has coords (data-markers) + description. robots.txt Crawl-delay: 1200 makes full runs take days; intentionally disabled.

gethome.label: GetHome
gethome.notes: window.__INITIAL_STATE__ JSON on search+detail; coordinates and descriptions present. robots.txt caps pagination at ?page=6.

gratka.label: Gratka
gratka.notes: Nuxt __NUXT_DATA__; detail pages expose coordinates + description; robots allows only ?page=2..10.

homeportal.label: HomePortal
homeportal.notes: Server-rendered listings with RealEstateListing JSON-LD; geo coordinates on detail pages.

kupbezposrednio.label: Kupbezpośrednio.pl
kupbezposrednio.notes: Next.js flight payload exposes coordinates and descriptions; detail pages confirm them via JSON-LD.

luksusowemieszkania.label: Luksusowe Mieszkania
luksusowemieszkania.notes: schema.org Product/AggregateOffer JSON-LD; geo on search and detail pages.

magazyny-online.label: Magazyny Online
magazyny-online.notes: Warehouse-park directory; JSON-LD Place.geo coordinates, floor size and full description on detail pages. Price on request.

morizon.label: Morizon
morizon.notes: Same Nuxt platform as Gratka; detail pages expose coordinates + description; robots allows only ?page=2..10.

nieruchomosci-online.label: Nieruchomości-online
nieruchomosci-online.notes: Schema.org JSON-LD; detail pages expose geo coordinates and full descriptions.

nieruchomosciowi.label: Nieruchomosciowi
nieruchomosciowi.notes: Public /api/v1 JSON API (coords + description); 60 req/min, nationwide feed.

nportal.label: Nportal
nportal.notes: Legacy server-rendered frontend; queries use HTTP because the TLS certificate does not match the hostname.

noweinwestycje.label: Nowe Inwestycje
noweinwestycje.notes: Homsters server-rendered cards; path pagination only (robots disallows query strings); detail exposes map coords and GmgDevelopmentEventData.

ogloszeniasyndyka.label: Ogłoszenia Syndyka
ogloszeniasyndyka.notes: Server-rendered cards; detail pages expose data-latitude/data-longitude. Very small inventory in małopolskie/śląskie.

okolica.label: Okolica
okolica.notes: City-level search paths only (no voivodeship URL); detail has data-lat/data-lng and full description. /pokoj/ is disallowed by robots.

oferty-net.label: Oferty.net
oferty-net.notes: Region paths plus data-lat/data-lng on detail pages.

otoprzetargi.label: Oto Przetargi
otoprzetargi.notes: Search + notice details; detail pages expose full text and map-centre coordinates.

olx.label: OLX
olx.notes: Server-rendered __PRERENDERED_STATE__; detail pages expose map coordinates and descriptions; 13 categories per region.

pkobp-nieruchomosci.label: PKO BP Nieruchomości
pkobp-nieruchomosci.notes: JSON search API exposes lat/lng; detail pages carry descriptions in __NEXT_DATA__ accordions.

pkp.label: PKP Sprzedaż
pkp.notes: GeoJSON offers on the sale page; coordinates on every offer; detail pages have full descriptions.

rentola.label: Rentola
rentola.notes: JSON-LD SearchResultsPage/RealEstateListing; geo on search and detail.

rentumo.label: Rentumo
rentumo.notes: Server-rendered cards; JSON-LD detail + map lat/lng.

rynekpierwotny.label: Rynek Pierwotny
rynekpierwotny.notes: Server-rendered __INITIAL_STATE__; investment detail exposes geo_point, description and the cheapest unit price.

sprzedajemy.label: Sprzedajemy.pl
sprzedajemy.notes: Server-rendered HTML + schema.org; detail pages expose data-coordinates and descriptions; 12 categories per region.

sprzedambiznes.label: Sprzedam Biznes
sprzedambiznes.notes: Server-rendered commercial cards; JSON-LD Product offers.areaServed.geo coordinates and full description. Legacy details without JSON-LD are skipped.

syndykaukcje.label: Syndyk Aukcje
syndykaukcje.notes: Listivo cards + OpenStreetMap :position coordinates on detail pages. Coordinate coverage is template-dependent.

szybko.label: Szybko.pl
szybko.notes: Server-rendered listings + JSON-LD; coordinates in map links.

szybkokomercyjne.label: Szybko Komercyjne
szybkokomercyjne.notes: Server-rendered search cards; detail JSON-LD + full description; OpenStreetMap iframe provides coordinates.

tauron.label: Tauron Nieruchomości
tauron.notes: Regional sale/lease list; detail pages expose data-latitude/data-longitude, descriptions and galleries. A minority of offers publish empty coordinates.

terenyprzemyslowe.label: Tereny Przemysłowe
terenyprzemyslowe.notes: Server-rendered HTML; detail pages embed a GeoJSON polygon. Filter by wojewodztwo + rodzaj; all results arrive on one page.

tabelaofert.label: Tabela Ofert
tabelaofert.notes: Next.js flight payload; investment detail exposes Product JSON-LD with unit geo, lowPrice and full description.

txo.label: TXO
txo.notes: Inertia JSON payload + RealEstateListing JSON-LD; coords on search and detail. Aggregates several other portals.

wybierzdewelopera.label: Wybierz Dewelopera
wybierzdewelopera.notes: WordPress, REST API disabled. Server-rendered cards; detail exposes Product JSON-LD, data-lat/data-lng and price per m² only (no total price).

partnersinternational.label: Partners International
partnersinternational.notes: Server-rendered cards; source coordinates when present, missing street addresses are geocoded.

vilea.label: Vilea
vilea.notes: Server-rendered JSON-LD; source coordinates when present, missing street addresses are geocoded.

allegrolokalnie.label: Allegro Lokalnie Nieruchomości
allegrolokalnie.notes: City paths only; street from structured Lokalizacja block; no coordinates, geocoder required. Live source currently returns HTTP 429; keep disabled until it recovers.

amw-nieruchomosci.label: AMW Nieruchomości
amw-nieruchomosci.notes: National tender list, path pagination; street address on detail, no source coordinates, geocoder required.

poczta-polska.label: Poczta Polska Nieruchomości
poczta-polska.notes: National sale/lease lists; street address on detail, no source coordinates, geocoder required.
